tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Aramaic te'oma, 'twin', via the Greek Thomas. Its root is Aramaic t-ʾ-m. Thomas the Apostle, called 'the Twin'. Thomas is a Aramaic name meaning “Twin”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
